Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.
This is an application seeking bail in FIR No. 136/2012 dated 30.09.2012, under Sections 406/420/120-B/174-A IPC, registered at Police Station-E.O.W.

It is stated by Mr Sabharwal,
learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant has no role to play in M/s. Money Bhandar and was not associated with the said company in any way.
He further states that the applicant is in judicial custody since 06.03.2021 and has been on interim bail as per HPC Guidelines from 19.05.2021 till 07.04.2023.
Issue notice.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 20:43:06 Mr Singh, learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.
He seeks and is granted two weeks to file a status report.
Nominal Roll be requisitioned indicating previous involvement of the applicant, if any.
JASMEET SINGH, J MAY 22, 2023 sr
